title: Al-Falaq
cue: The second of the three surahs at bedtime

usage.evidence: Aishah reports that each night, on going to bed, the Prophet ﷺ cupped his hands, blew into them and recited these three surahs, then wiped as much of his body as he could, three times (al-Bukhari 5017).
